prompt: Build the agreed CSV export feature in src/csv-export.ts with focused tests beside it. Export encodeCsv(records: ReadonlyArray<Readonly<Record<string, string | number | null>>>, columns: ReadonlyArray<string>): string. Always emit the columns header in the supplied order, then one row per record. Null and missing values become empty cells. Quote cells containing commas, double quotes or line breaks; double embedded quotes. Use CRLF row separators and include a final CRLF. Empty records still emit the header. Handle Unicode without changing it. Keep this independent of the UI and other export formats.
